references.title: Jubilee V2.2.2 hardware
facts: CoreXY multi-tool motion platform
Published STEP, SolidWorks and fabrication files
300 x 300 x 300 mm stated build volume
references.use: Pinned original jubilee.STEP is the foundation of new chat-generated liquid workstations; source assembly and attribution are retained
references.limits: Only the identified STEP asset is imported. Custom inserts/tools/mounts, proposed bed pose, connections and hardware operation remain unverified. The legacy XYZ simulation does not validate Jubilee.

references.title: Science Jubilee laboratory tools
references.license: MIT (repository); upstream hardware has separate licensing
facts: Python interface for a Jubilee laboratory platform
Documents OT-2 pipette, syringe and camera tools
Tool and labware calibration is still required
references.use: Documented reference for pipette/camera modular workflows and integration advice
references.limits: No Science Jubilee control code or CAD is installed in MuseAutoLab. A reference workflow is not a compatible ready-made adapter or verified liquid-handling result.

references.title: Pololu 1209 NEMA 14 motor body
references.license: Manufacturer documentation; no vendor CAD redistributed
facts: 35 mm square x 36 mm body, excluding shaft
1 A per phase
5 mm shaft diameter
references.use: Exact stated motor-body envelope inside the custom carriage when selected
references.limits: Body envelope only, not complete supplier CAD. Mount holes, shaft clearance, torque sizing, transmission and controls remain unverified. Price retains the separately dated catalogue snapshot.

references.title: Pololu 1208 NEMA 14 motor body
references.license: Manufacturer documentation; no vendor CAD redistributed
facts: 35 mm square x 28 mm body, excluding shaft
0.5 A per phase
5 mm shaft diameter
references.use: Exact stated alternative motor-body envelope; fixed body is not scaled to fit
references.limits: Body envelope only. Substitution does not establish adequate motor torque, shaft clearance or electrical compatibility. Price retains the separately dated snapshot.

references.title: Raspberry Pi Camera Module 3, standard lens
references.license: Manufacturer documentation; no vendor CAD redistributed
facts: Published standard-lens overall dimensions 25 x 24 x 11.5 mm
12 megapixel IMX708 sensor
CSI-2 interface; requires a compatible host and cable
references.use: Manufacturer overall envelope of the downward camera; Y is the optical/thickness axis
references.limits: Schematic envelope, not vendor CAD. The custom bracket is separate; host, cable, field of view and calibration are unresolved. Browser photo capture is not a CSI hardware driver. Price is unknown.

references.title: Opentrons Temperature Module GEN2 body
references.license: Manufacturer documentation; no vendor CAD redistributed
facts: Published body dimensions 194 mm long x 90 mm wide x 84 mm high
Top plate temperature differs from sample temperature
Thermal block and sample configuration require separate review
references.use: Existing sourced outer envelope when the commercial cooling variant is selected
references.limits: Only the outer dimensions are sourced. Displayed enclosure details are a custom proxy, not vendor CAD; thermal performance and compatibility with this workstation remain unverified.

references.title: Opentrons OT-2 assembled liquid-handling platform
references.license: Manufacturer specifications; pinned software deck definition Apache-2.0; no vendor machine CAD
facts: Catalogue explicitly states W630 x D570 x H660 mm
11 working deck slots plus removable trash and two compatible pipette mounts
System documentation requires 200 mm around the instrument for ventilation
Software deck slot coordinates are pinned and hash-checked; no robot driver is installed
references.use: Explicitly selected ready-made platform route, quote/setup guidance and bounded schematic slot layout
references.limits: Frame, internal height and labware/pipette bodies are schematic. Only published outer envelope and deck-relative software slot grid are bound. Confirm actual instrument/labware compatibility, access space, calibration, configuration, price, stock and delivery. A manual pipette is not assumed compatible. The software adapter does not operate or physically validate the robot.
